data.exact_reserve_text:
Partially offsetting the favourable premium variance in the period was an increase in incurred claims particularly on the 2015 year of account, primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount.

The directors approved the closure of the 2015 Year of Account by reinsurance to close into the 2016 year of account of the Syndicate. The year closed at a loss of GBP 64k following a calendar year profit of GBP 864k and a brought-forward retained loss after 24 months of GBP 928k. The result at 36 months follows the increase in incurred claims primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount. The closing result will be called in April 2018.

data.standardized_narrative: On a gross basis the syndicate recorded a small overall prior-year release of approximately GBP 0.32m. This modest favourable movement is calculated from the syndicate's gross claims development table and reflects releases in older underwriting years that were partly offset by adverse development on the 2015 year driven by an increase in average claim size; the 2015 year was closed by reinsurance to close into 2016 and closed with a small loss at 36 months.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 29) as no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was present. The managing agent narrative refers to increased incurred claims on the 2015 year (net context) and the closure of the 2015 year by reinsurance to close into 2016; this RITC and net/gross distinction may explain differences between narrative (which references net movements and year-of-account closure) and the small gross release derived from the triangle. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' comparative column (2016) on page 12.
